sql: WITH target_assays AS (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1871') AND assay_tax_id = 9606), molecule_list AS (SELECT DISTINCT molregno FROM activities WHERE assay_id IN (SELECT assay_id FROM target_assays) AND standard_type = 'IC50' AND pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molregno LIMIT 1000) SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM molecule_list ml JOIN activities act ON act.molregno = ml.molregno AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ml.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id

Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH filtered_activities AS (SELECT activities.activity_id, activities.assay_id, activities.molregno, activities.pchembl_value, activities.standard_type, assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1871' AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606 ORDER BY activities.molregno, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000) SELECT fa.assay_chembl_id, fa.target_type, fa.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, fa.standard_type, fa.pchembl_value FROM filtered_activities fa JOIN molecule_dictionary ON fa.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON fa.molregno = compound_structures.molregno ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, fa.assay_chembl_id
